$comment: Journey-time model. Edge time = distance / runningSpeed + dwell at the arriving station.
These are AVERAGE running speeds between adjacent stops, not top speeds, and they are
calibrated against real end-to-end journey times rather than picked from the air:
Western slow  Churchgate–Virar   60.18 km, 28 hops → 102 min   (real ≈ 95–105 min)
Western fast  Churchgate–Virar   60.18 km, 15 hops →  73 min   (real ≈ 70–75 min)
Line 3        Aarey–Cuffe Parade 32.69 km, 26 hops →  54 min   (real ≈ 50 min)
Line 1        Versova–Ghatkopar  10.90 km, 11 hops →  19 min   (real ≈ 21 min)
Times only affect route RANKING, never fare, so they are lower-risk than fare data — but
a badly wrong time model would recommend the wrong route, so it is still calibrated.
The monorail figure is the one primary-sourced value here: MMRDA publishes a scheduled speed

metro.note: Typical Indian metro average running speed between adjacent stations.

fast.note: Fast services run longer stretches at higher speed and hold slightly longer at their fewer stops.

$transferPenaltyNote: Added on top of walk time when changing line, to represent waiting for the next service. Applied by the routing engine, not baked into edges.
